title: Bounded abstraction durable evidence

package.description: Immutable EvidencePackage of authored source excerpts, separately typed deterministic observations and exact selection identity; validated on read. Supplied observations carry operation, units, inspected scope and exactness as protected data, remain derived, and cannot attest acronym expansions.

accounting.description: Source/selection identity, calls, reserved complete prompt/output tokens and limits. Reservations precede inference and survive retries/recovery.

raw.description: Bounded raw generation text kept off served discovery surfaces.

truncated.description: Whether raw diagnostic retention reached its character ceiling.

sha256.description: Hash of complete raw generation text, including any unretained tail.

generation.description: Processing attempt owning the private candidate diagnostic.

candidate.description: Private bounded raw-generation diagnostic, atomically published with hybrid quality; never a public abstract or retrieval admission surface.

description: Internal documents.abstraction_state JSONB. Replacing evidence preserves accounting for the source; source changes start a new attributable scope.
